dedupe_keys.name: charging demand for medium and heavy duty battery electric trucks in finland 2030 and 2050

description: This dataset gives scenario estimates of the electricity demand and charging power that medium and heavy-duty battery electric trucks would need in Finland in 2030 and 2050. Starting from a five-year (2018 to 2022) national road freight origin-destination survey, a detailed trip chain analysis assigns charging to six charger groups by charging activity (off-shift or mid-shift), ownership (private or public) and trip profile (urban, short-haul, long-haul, one or two drivers), with megawatt and combined charging systems. Eight GIS layers give best and worst cases with and without opportunity charging at loading and unloading: municipality-zone maps of all charging demand and 10 km grid maps of public on-road charging demand, as shapefiles with CSV tables and QGIS styles. It was produced by Tampere University and VTT and published on 2 May 2025. Coverage is national, by municipality and 10 km grid cell, for medium-term (2030) and long-term (2050) horizons, plus a full-electrification case for 2050. Data are free on Zenodo under CC BY-SA 4.0. Caveats: the results are model scenarios, not observations, and the methodology paper was not yet linked from the record. The data support capacity planning of truck charging networks, network flow studies of electric road freight and grid connection planning, alongside the European truck charging datasets catalogued here.
